result:
Step 1 is complete. Here's what was done:

**What was built:**
- `src/utils/slugs.ts` — extracted the five pure helpers (`getPostSlug`, `getPostCategory`, `formatDate`, `extractFirstImage`, `getPostsByCategory`) into a vitest-safe module with no Astro/Cloudinary imports. `posts.ts` imports and re-exports from it, so all call sites are unchanged.
- `src/utils/posts.test.ts` — 20 tests covering all five helpers
- `vitest.config.ts` — minimal node environment config
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — push + PR trigger, Node 22, runs `npm ci` → `astro check` → `vitest run` → `npm run build`
- Added `"test"` and `"check"` scripts to `package.json`

**One fix needed after first push:** CI build failed because `PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME` wasn't set in the runner. It's a `PUBLIC_` prefixed Astro variable already embedded in all rendered HTML, so it's safe inline in the workflow. Added it; CI passed on the second push.

**CI run:** https://github.com/rodmachen/edition-rodmachen-com/actions/runs/27396032384 — all steps green.
